TASK: Initialize and build the Tauri Android project for this workspace, recording go/no-go gate evidence for the architecture decision (T=tauri-plugin path vs G=pure gradle fallback).

CONTEXT: Repo root /Users/wingwogus/orca/workspaces/hanbeon/feat-android-tauri. This is a Tauri v2 app (apps/desktop). Environment already set up: NDK 26.3 at ~/Library/Android/sdk/ndk/26.3.11579264, rust target aarch64-linux-android installed, cargo tauri-cli 2.11.4 available via PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH, ANDROID_HOME=~/Library/Android/sdk. A machine-local .cargo/config.toml with NDK linker paths already exists (gitignored).

DELIVERABLE:
1. Run: cd apps/desktop && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk cargo tauri android init
2. If init succeeds: cargo tauri android build --debug --target aarch64 2>&1 | tail -30, capture exit code and APK path
3. Write evidence to .omo/evidence/android-spike-gate.md with sections: INIT_RESULT, BUILD_RESULT, APK_PATH or FAIL_REASON, BRANCH_DECISION (T if build+install plausible, G if structurally blocked), NEXT_STEPS
4. Commit generated gen/ directory files if init succeeds: git add gen/ && git commit -m "chore(android): tauri android project scaffold" (only if gen/ exists)

SCOPE: Only touch apps/desktop/gen/, .gitignore additions if needed for build artifacts, and .omo/evidence/. Do NOT modify Rust source code, do NOT modify tauri.conf.json windows config.

VERIFY: Evidence file exists with all four sections filled; either an APK path is recorded or FAIL_REASON explains the structural blockage.

STOP WHEN: Evidence file written and any successful scaffold committed.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Refactor the desktop Tauri crate to consume the shared hanbeon-core crate instead of owning platform-free logic inline, keeping ALL desktop behavior identical.

CONTEXT: Repo root /Users/wingwogus/orca/workspaces/hanbeon/feat-android-tauri. The workspace already has crates/hanbeon-core (platform-free scan state machine, adapt, journal, profile, preset, gesture, host trait - ported from the proven reference repo) registered in workspace members, and apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml already has hanbeon-core as a path dependency. The desktop crate still has its own inline implementations: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/{scan.rs(1293 lines),adapt.rs,journal.rs,profile.rs,preset.rs,action.rs,input.rs} which contain tauri::AppHandle coupling (scan.rs line 26 uses tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter, Manager}, profile.rs:122-151 uses AppHandle for paths, journal.rs:108-185 same).

GOAL: Desktop src-tauri keeps ONLY platform glue (window.rs, tray.rs, occlusion.rs, focused_application/, arduino.rs serial I/O, audio.rs, led.rs, shortcut.rs, emit.rs, lib.rs command handlers). The platform-free decision logic should call into crates/hanbeon-core functions/types instead of duplicating them.

APPROACH HINTS:
- The reference shape is in-repo: crates/hanbeon-core/src/host.rs defines a Host trait (inject/undo/open_settings/fit_cells/cue/set_sound/publish/save_profile) - desktop should implement this trait with its existing enigo/tauri code.
- Do NOT delete desktop modules wholesale. Move shared types/logic into hanbeon-core only when they have no tauri dependency; where desktop code calls AppHandle.emit or reads paths from Manager, keep those as thin adapters implementing the core's traits.
- Priority: make it compile and pass tests first, perfect boundary separation second. If full extraction is too risky in one pass, extract incrementally: start with modules that have zero tauri imports today (check adapt.rs, preset.rs, action.rs), then scan.rs state machine.

DELIVERABLE: Modified files under apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/ and crates/hanbeon-core/src/ such that: cargo check --workspace passes, cargo test --workspace passes, bun run lint passes.

SCOPE: May edit apps/desktop/src-tauri/**, crates/hanbeon-core/**, Cargo.toml files. Must NOT change frontend (apps/desktop/src), must NOT change user-visible behavior, must NOT add new features. Must NOT touch apps/desktop/gen/ (another worker owns it).

VERIFY: PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo test --workspace exits 0 AND PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings exits 0 AND grep -rn "use tauri" crates/hanbeon-core/src/ returns nothing.

STOP WHEN: All three verification commands pass, or you have made maximal safe progress and documented exactly what remains in .omo/evidence/core-extraction-status.md

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Run the desktop regression gate after the core extraction refactor and produce a pass/fail evidence file.

CONTEXT: Repo root /Users/wingwogus/orca/workspaces/hanbeon/feat-android-tauri. Another worker has just refactored apps/desktop/src-tauri to consume crates/hanbeon-core. Your job is verification only - do NOT fix anything, just report.

DELIVERABLE: Run these exact commands from repo root, capture exit codes and last 10-15 lines of output each:
1. PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo test --workspace 2>&1 | tail -15
2. PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -10
3. bun run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -5
4. bun run test --bail 1 2>&1 | tail -10
5. PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo build -p hanbeon 2>&1 | tail -3

Write results to .omo/evidence/regression-gate.md with a PASS/FAIL verdict per command and an overall "GATE: PASS" or "GATE: FAIL" line.

SCOPE: Read-only on source code. Write only to .omo/evidence/regression-gate.md. Do not modify any source files even if you see failures - report them.

VERIFY: The evidence file exists and contains all 5 command results plus an overall verdict line.

STOP WHEN: Evidence file written.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Produce the final completion audit for the Android packaging prep session.

CONTEXT: Repo root /Users/wingwogus/orca/workspaces/hanbeon/feat-android-tauri. Three prior workers produced: (1) .omo/evidence/android-spike-gate.md - tauri android init/build gate evidence with branch decision, (2) refactored crates/hanbeon-core consumption in apps/desktop/src-tauri, (3) .omo/evidence/regression-gate.md - regression test results.

DELIVERABLE: Read .omo/evidence/android-spike-gate.md and .omo/evidence/regression-gate.md. Then run: git status --short and git log --oneline -8. Write .omo/evidence/final-audit.md containing four sections:
1. What was accomplished (environment setup, spike result, extraction status, regression status)
2. What remains before real-device testing (concrete next steps from the spike evidence NEXT_STEPS section)
3. Any FAIL verdicts found and their meaning
4. Overall readiness verdict: READY-FOR-DEVICE-TESTING or NEEDS-MORE-WORK with one-line reason

SCOPE: Read-only everywhere except writing .omo/evidence/final-audit.md.

VERIFY: final-audit.md exists with all four sections and references both input evidence files by name.

STOP WHEN: Audit file written.
